title: Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out - Wikipedia
notes: Born to Run, 1975; a single in December 1975. Personnel: Max Weinberg, drums.

title: She's the One (Bruce Springsteen song) - Wikipedia
notes: Born to Run, 1975. Personnel: Max Weinberg, drums.

title: Badlands (Bruce Springsteen song) - Wikipedia
notes: "A brief drum intro kicks in to a powerful piano-and-electric guitar riff. The song is taken fast, with Max Weinberg's dynamic drumming; indeed it contains his most well-known beat, a one-two-three-four-five-six-(double time) one-two-three pattern underneath the verses." Personnel: Max Weinberg, drums.

title: Born in the U.S.A. (song) - Wikipedia
notes: Take 4, 27 April 1982, Power Station; much of the arrangement made up on the spot, including what Chuck Plotkin called Weinberg's "exploding drums". The snare's sound: the top mic through a broken reverb plate with a fixed four-second decay into a Kepex gate (Toby Scott). The video, directed by John Sayles, is concert footage synchronised with the studio recording. Personnel: Max Weinberg, drums.

title: Dancing in the Dark (Bruce Springsteen song) - Wikipedia
notes: Born in the U.S.A., 1984; the first single. Personnel: Max Weinberg, drums.

title: Glory Days (Bruce Springsteen song) - Wikipedia
notes: Born in the U.S.A., 1984; a single in 1985. The album's personnel lists Weinberg on drums throughout.

title: Bruce Springsteen - Born in the U.S.A. (Official Video), directed by John Sayles, 1984 (YouTube EPhWR4d3FJQ)
notes: Tour footage cut with the studio recording. Looked at frame by frame at 4:05-4:13: Weinberg at the kit in a pale grey long-sleeved shirt, its collar open, a dark buttoned waistcoat, thin wire-framed glasses, short dark hair; shells that read white under blue light, chrome hardware; matched grip.
